|game_text='''0 side — Imperial Occupation'''

Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker){{!}}Ice Plains]], and [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (V) (Virtual Block 6){{!}}Main Power Generators]] (Light Side). May deploy [[Imperial Decree]]. For remainder of game, [[Walker Garrison]] is an Out Of Play Interrupt and [Immune to Sense]. AT-ATs are deploy -1 to marker sites. While this side up, [[Revolution]] is canceled. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force to your [Special Edition] Effects. During your control phase, may ▲ one [[AT-AT Cannon]], [[Hoth Blockade]], [[Electro-Rangefinder]], or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away' and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.

'''7 side — Imperial Control'''

While this side up, Revolution is canceled. At marker sites, AT-ATs move for free. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may retrieve any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) into hand. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a marker site. Flip this card if Hoth Blockade not on Hoth.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here are the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slips of the two sides ([[:File:VB2-72E-Imperial_Occupation.png]], [[:File:VB2-72E-Imperial_Control.png]]), which show this text. The Players Committee card image of the 7 side ([[:File:VB2-D-imperialcontrol-pre.gif]]) prints the PC-E1 text (see [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]]). The Players Committee card image of the 0 side ([[:File:VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif]], marked E) prints a third front text that is in no dated source found so far: “Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] Ice Plains, and [Virtual Block 8] Main Power Generators. May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, Walker Garrison is an Out Of Play Interrupt and [Immune to Sense]. AT-ATs are deploy -1 to marker sites. Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing is canceled. While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Once during your turn, may ▲ one AT-AT Cannon, Hoth Blockade, Electro-Rangefinder, or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators ‘blown away’ and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.” It is not listed as a version until its source and date are known (held for a ruling, 9 November 2026).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, slips marked E) rewrote the 0 side (Walker Garrison “may only be played once per game”, Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing canceled, “Once during your turn”, no Force-loss limit) and dropped “At marker sites, AT-ATs move for free.” from the 7 side: 0 side “Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] Ice Plains, and [Virtual Block 8] Main Power Generators. May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, AT-ATs deploy -1 to marker sites. Walker Garrison may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing is canceled. While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Once during your turn, may ▲ one AT-AT Cannon, Hoth Blockade, Electro-Rangefinder, or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away' and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.” 7 side “While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may retrieve any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) into hand. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a marker site. Flip this card if Hoth Blockade not on Hoth.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
